title: CircuitCraft 2.0
subtitle: PCB Design Using KiCad
description: Building on the success of its first edition, Samarthya - The Electronics Technical Club of SJEC conducted CircuitCraft 2.0 from 16th - 18th March 2026, tailored for fourth-semester students. The three-day Student Development Programme (SDP) introduced 132 participants to the complete PCB development cycle, from schematic design and component selection to board layout, routing, and fabrication. Students designed, debugged, and validated a functional infrared (IR) receiver circuit.

title: CircuitCraft
subtitle: PCB Design Using KiCad
description: From 4th - 6th February 2026, Samarthya conducted CircuitCraft, a three-day hands-on Student Development Programme (SDP) on PCB design using KiCad, in collaboration with the SJEC-AICTE IDEA Lab and with support from Prodigi. The programme guided 119 sixth-semester students through the complete PCB design workflow, designing an infrared (IR) receiver circuit from start to finish.
tagline: From schematic to board learning by building

title: Electrovation 2.0
subtitle: Project Pitch & Seed Funding
description: On 24th January 2026, Samarthya conducted Electrovation 2.0 at the DSP Lab, SJEC Mangaluru. The event provided a platform for students to pitch innovative, technically feasible, and industry-relevant project ideas, bringing together 40 students across 11 competitive teams. Six projects were selected for seed-funding support: SpineAlign, Explorer, NeuroPulse, SignalX, Impedance, and Sahayog.
